system.description: You snare a foe with a chain-hook or a rope and spur your beast away. Make a melee attack (DR16) against a foe within reach. On a success, it takes d12 damage and is knocked Prone. Sustained: it is Restrained by your chain, and each time you ride, it is dragged behind you and takes d4 damage. At the start of its turn, the Dark Master rolls a d20 and it breaks free on 14 or higher (a player character tests Strength DR14 instead). The Dark Master may rule a foe too vast to drag; then your beast is held in place instead.

outcomes.failure: Half damage, and the chain slips free.
outcomes.ruin: The chain wraps your own arm: you are pulled from the saddle and land Prone beside the foe.
